findings.description: A read-only viewer can modify expenses: POST /expenses/1 returns 303 and changes the record (title/amount overwritten), while create and delete correctly return 403.
repro: Open /expenses: expense 1 changed and total altered

findings.description: The edit form page is served with 200 to a viewer, while /expenses/new returns 403 for the same role.

notes: Totals and category filters were correct. No upper amount limit (99999999999 accepted), not reported.
